sample_unit: notes (20 paired notes from simulated consultations)
models_evaluated: two unnamed language models used as automated reviewers/risk graders

links.outcome: Errors (unsupported statements, omissions) in AI scribe notes versus professional notes, transcript-grounded
links.effect: Automated-reviewer all-error density 3.35 (AI) vs 8.55 (professional) per note; omissions 1.45 vs 5.20; Critical+High density 0.35 vs 0.75 (difference 0.40, 95% CI −0.10 to 1.00), inconclusive.
links.quote: Automated-reviewer all-error density was 3.35 vs 8.55 per note (professional-minus-AI difference 5.20, 95% CI 3.85 to 6.55); omission density was 1.45 vs 5.20 (difference 3.75, 2.80 to 4.65).

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality and error burden of an ambient AI scribe (Heidi) compared to allied health professional notes in a paired simulation study.
